$schema_note: VIGIL feature-wiring completeness audit (W15-2 #394, feeding the W17 milestone). Machine-checked by docs/tests/test_feature_wiring_status.py, which runs in the required 'the briefing explains every agent and capability' CI job. JSON, not YAML, on purpose: that job installs only pytest. Every feature carries a machine-readable wiring status; the guard verifies each status against the code and extends the system-map drift invariant with a COVERAGE check over the enumerable CLI surface (native verbs == sub.add_parser set; passthrough verbs == the dispatch _ENV table), so no verb can be silently added, removed, or mis-declared. See docs/features/wiring-status.md.

statuses.LIVE: Shipped and unconditionally invokable; produces its effect on the default path.
statuses.OPT-IN: Shipped but off by default; the operator turns it on explicitly.
statuses.GATED: Shipped but its effect is behind an authorization/approval/quorum gate or is deploy-gated on infra.
statuses.BUILT-NOT-WIRED: The symbol exists (interface/stub/scaffold) but no runtime reaches it; a stub raises NotImplementedError or a scaffold is an abstract interface only.
statuses.ORPHANED: A registered surface (e.g. a console read route) that nothing consumes; detection is enforced by the W17-14 orphan-route guard. No feature is ORPHANED today.

features.name: Pluggable next-gen agent body
features.rationale: An ABC interface only (think->propose->gate->execute->learn); the Strix-based body is the one shipping implementation, no next-gen body is wired.

features.name: Hardware-backed (TEE) attestation
features.rationale: SEV-SNP/TDX providers exist behind the interface but every method raises NotImplementedError until the silicon lands; SoftwareAttestationProvider is the working default (integrity+origin, not hardware confidentiality).
